signals.title: A weather check before the next launch
signals.summary: Demo: a trip is approaching. Review the current official forecast and local conditions before deciding how to proceed.

details.signal: Synthetic scenario only; no actual forecast or booking was read.
details.why: A short human review can surface conditions that deserve a change of plan.
details.next: If preparing a trip, open the official forecast and review conditions before choosing the next step.
details.prompt: Help me build a short pre-trip weather review checklist. Keep unknowns explicit; do not issue a safe-to-go decision.

signals.title: One last check for a smooth handoff
signals.summary: Demo: the rental checklist has an unanswered readiness item. Confirm the source before treating it as a customer issue.

details.signal: Synthetic rental readiness report: one checklist item has no recorded answer.
details.why: A verified handoff can prevent avoidable friction for a guest.
details.next: If the checklist is still incomplete, verify the item and note the result.
details.prompt: Turn this verified checklist gap into a 20-minute next step. Do not assume payment, damage, or guest obligations.

signals.title: A client answer can unlock the build
signals.summary: Demo: a software deliverable depends on a client decision. Prepare the smallest useful question; review before sending.

details.signal: Synthetic project note: the next build step depends on one client decision.
details.why: A focused question can reduce rework without starting another implementation.
details.next: If the decision is still open, draft one question with two concrete options.
details.prompt: Draft a concise question about the missing decision. Separate the source fact from your assumptions. Do not send anything.

signals.title: A good session is worth remembering
signals.summary: Demo: a golfer shared encouraging feedback. Keep the win; there is no follow-up required.

details.signal: Synthetic feedback example: a guest enjoyed a simulator session.
details.why: Positive feedback is useful context, even when it creates no task.
details.next: Nothing is required. Keep this as a useful signal.

signals.title: The smaller fix passed its checks
signals.summary: Demo: the sample software change passed its local checks. That is progress, with production verification still separate.

details.signal: Synthetic test report: the focused local checks passed.
details.why: A verified local result is progress. It does not prove deployment or live integrations.
details.next: Nothing required from this signal. Keep any release decision with its owner.

signals.title: Make room for one useful improvement
signals.summary: Demo: compare one open slot across fishing, rentals, and golf. Use a dated source and the right capacity unit before drawing a conclusion.

details.signal: Synthetic planning note: capacity sources have not been compared.
details.why: Guide slots, rental hours, and bay-hours use different denominators.
details.next: If you have 15 minutes, pick one business and verify one gap against its source.
details.prompt: Build a small capacity comparison with period, source, denominator, and unknowns. Do not invent benchmarks or treat one-time consulting fees as MRR.

signals.title: This note needs a fresh look
signals.summary: Demo: an older source may no longer describe the business. Check the original before repeating its recommendation.

details.signal: Synthetic archived report: its last observation is over a week old.
details.why: Old reports can repeat resolved work or contradict a newer source.
details.next: If this still matters, open the original and look for an update.

signals.title: A larger dependency deserves a decision
signals.summary: Demo: a service issue would need more time than a quick triage session. Keep it visible and arrange capacity before attempting the fix.

details.signal: Synthetic service disruption example; no live incident was detected.
details.why: A short time budget must not hide a potentially important dependency.
details.next: If the issue is verified, reserve focused time or ask the owner for a smaller safe step.
